decisions.reason: As an extension of the firm's established psychiatric and therapeutic services, this program fits existing expertise and research capacity, and its dedicated web page suggests committed market support.

Although more commercial than core care services, the carpentry workshop still builds on the firm's workshop and practical-therapy know-how, so the firm is likely to retain it while learning and refining the offer.
Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the firm's established mental health and support activities, making it easy to absorb and improve even if its web presence is still modest.
This counseling service is strongly related to the firm's eldercare activities and its visibility on the home page signals strategic relevance and good prospects for continuation.
The retail shop is related to the firm's sheltered-workshop activities and inclusion mission, so despite somewhat higher market risk the firm is likely to keep it as a complementary outlet.
